signal: AudioEye reported record Q1 2026 results at $41.2M ARR and released its 2026 Accessibility Advantage Report showing 59% of orgs at legal risk

email.body1:
Olivia, saw AudioEye hit record Q1 results at $41.2M ARR and that your 2026 report found 59% of orgs would fail an accessibility audit today.

That demand creates more accounts than a BDR team can follow up on fast, and follow-up volume plus ramp time is usually where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and sequences autonomously, so your reps spend time in conversations instead of admin: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had it draft 3 personalized emails to AudioEye's top 3 target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body2:
Olivia, quick follow-up for AudioEye.

With the awareness your report is driving, response speed becomes the constraint: leads cool while reps research and write. Multi-channel sequencing run by a worker tends to lift responses 287% over single channel, and tighter emails add another 67%.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Olivia, last bit of proof for AudioEye.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how AudioEye's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Olivia, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If helping your BDRs cover more accounts without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know managing follow-up volume and ramp is its own full-time job.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays for a BDR team? I'll tailor it to AudioEye either way.
